text:
maya: Quick heads-up — FieldTech wants a 2-week private POC on their on-prem cluster. They have 4x A40s and want Redwood Private installed in their air-gapped VLAN. Need a concise preflight checklist and who owns access/setup. cc @raj @sam @iris

raj: I can own the install guide & run the preflight. Need exact driver / CUDA versions and k8s distro. Ask them for node images and kubeconfig.

maya: They've got RHEL 8.8, kernel 5.15, k8s 1.25 (managed by in-house team). Confirmed containerd runtime.

nora: Also flag pricing — they asked about Dedicated vs Private for POC. Short answer: for two weeks, Private POC is billed as project-based professional services + usage estimate. I'll follow up on numbers.

sam: RHEL 8.8 + kernel 5.15 + A40 is fine, but drivers must match CUDA. Minimum tested stack: NVIDIA driver 535.x, CUDA 12.1, and NVIDIA container toolkit for containerd. Need to verify NCCL 2.18 compatibility for multi-GPU.

iris: Security checklist: VPN or temporary site-to-site tunnel, bastion host, KMS access pattern (they'll keep keys on-prem), and we need signed-off access window & account owner. Also request their internal SOC contact for the questionnaire.

maya: They want us to avoid long-lived credentials. Preferred: One-time API key scoped to POC and a short-lived SSH cert for bastion.

raj: For preflight commands to ask them to run and paste results (safe output):
```
# GPU/driver
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total --format=csv
# CUDA
cat /usr/local/cuda/version.txt || nvcc --version
# Kernel
uname -r
# K8s
kubectl version --short
kubectl get nodes -o wide
# Container runtime
crictl info | grep runtime
# Device plugin
kubectl -n kube-system get daemonset nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset -o yaml || echo "not installed"
```

sam: Add checks for cgroups v1 vs v2 and selinux status: `cat /proc/filesystems | grep cgroup` and `sestatus`. Also ensure swap is off: `sudo swapoff -a` and kubelet configured accordingly.

raj: We'll need node labels/taints for scheduling Redwood pods: request they create a node pool or add label `redwood/poc=true` and allow us to schedule privileged pods.

iris: Firewall rules: open outbound to our control plane endpoints (we'll provide CIDRs) and allow SSH from bastion IP. If fully air-gapped, we need an offline bundle and install media — that extends lead time by 3–5 days.

maya: They said "no internet egress" by default. I flagged offline bundle. FieldTech will confirm if a temporary tunnel is possible.

nora: On pricing: I'll prepare a short quote: 2-week Private POC fee (services + 2 wks runtime) and an optional Dedicated trial estimate if they want to compare.

raj: Install windows: 1) collect outputs above, 2) confirm SSH access to a bastion & kubeconfig, 3) provide node label or role, 4) confirm offline vs online. If offline, we schedule a packaging run and remote exec windows.

deploy-bot: CI deploy scheduled: redwood-private/offline-bundle-2026-03-25 02:00 UTC (if requested)

sam: Extra hardware note: A40 memory configuration matters for batch sizes. Ask them for expected peak seq len and tokens/sec target so we can size vcores and shared memory.

maya: Action items:
- FieldTech to run preflight commands (raj)
- FieldTech to confirm VPN vs offline bundle (maya)
